name: Human Resources & Payroll Lifecycle Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Human Resources and Payroll (Hire-to-Retire), covering applicant tracking (ATS), offer management, employee onboarding, attendance, leave management, payroll processing, tax calculation, benefits, performance appraisals, and exit offboarding.
owner: Global Human Resources & Payroll Operations Office

checklists.name: Human Resources & Payroll Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ATS hiring, payroll calculation accuracy, statutory tax filings, and offboarding de-provisioning.

items.statement: New hires complete background verification and Form I-9 / national identity verification prior to day 1.
Time and attendance inputs are approved by department managers before locking payroll cycles.
Gross-to-net calculations match tax withholding tables and statutory deduction limits.
Direct deposit payment files (NACHA/Bank Transfer) undergo dual executive sign-off prior to transmission.
Terminated employee system accounts (email, VPN, SSO, building badge) are revoked on the effective departure date.

reviewGates.name: Payroll & HR Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The HR & Payroll Director confirms that payroll calculations, statutory tax filings, and offboarding steps satisfy labor laws.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the HR & Payroll audit package confirm calculation accuracy and regulatory compliance?
